summary: Tested PRD v2.2 Phase 2 (Master Scam Taxonomy) + Phase 5 (Higgins Findings Brief) backend, the 2 frontend bug fixes, and the new DetailedFindingsBrief UI. All checks passed: full backend pytest suite (1898 passed, 16 skipped, 1 xpassed, 0 failures), targeted new test files (61/61 passed), frontend reportSections/luddish/plainEnglish suite (40/40 passed), full frontend regression (exactly 32 pre-existing failures, unchanged from baseline — no new regressions), and a live end-to-end run through the actual app UI (onboarding -> Ask Higgins -> Messages & Calls check -> OTP/credential-sharing bank-impersonation text) that reached TC Hawkeye settlement and rendered the new 'Detailed Findings Brief' collapsible correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: taxonomy.py and findings_brief.py are clean, well-documented, and correctly scoped (pure classification/re-presentation, no new facts invented). report.compose() correctly guards the taxonomy/findingsBrief attachment inside the TC Hawkeye-settled path only, as scoped.

DetailedFindingsBrief.tsx correctly guards on `response?.findingsBrief` presence, uses CollapsibleSection (collapsed by default), and all 6 headers + taxonomy tag render with proper testIDs. No crash observed for the null case (component simply isn't mounted — verified via code inspection, not forced-tested, since this session's scope excludes Magnum DI/legacy paths per context note).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on in-scope files (40/40); full suite unchanged at 32 known pre-existing unrelated failures (1324/1356 passed)

seed_data_creation: None — no persistent data created; the E2E test used an anonymous device auto-registered by the app's onboarding flow (standard for this app, no accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend suite takes ~260s with live Gemini calls (APOLLO_PREVIEW_SIMULATOR not set in this env) — use the tool's own `timeout` parameter (not `timeout <n>` inside the bash command) set to 280-300s in a single foreground call; backgrounding via `&` gets killed between tool calls so don't rely on it for long-running pytest runs. E2E UI testing of this app requires doing onboarding + navigation + submission all within ONE browser_automation script call, since state/session does not persist between separate tool invocations (each call appears to get a fresh browser context). The reliable path to trigger a full TC Hawkeye investigation (not just the quick local checkMessage path used by text-guard.tsx/message.tsx) is: tab-ask -> ask-check-button -> higgins-check-messages_calls -> fill higgins-artifact-content -> higgins-artifact-submit, then poll for [data-testid='inv-findings-brief-toggle'].
